name: c27j-icon-gunkit-fal

references.role: our approved upgrade icon (the drill rig's work lights): match outline weight, shading, palette and finish only; do not copy its shape
our approved upgrade icon of an aircraft fit (the Osprey's infrared jammer): match its finish only; do not copy its shape

art_plan.why: the same icon on Nano Banana Pro through fal, after OpenAI's filter refused both tries as a weapon (26 Nov 2026; rule 7: a refusal changes the route); within the owner's US$1.19 cap for these icons

prompt:
GAME UPGRADE ICON. One single object seen from above at about sixty degrees, centred, as an icon on a button in a top-down strategy game.

Image 1 is our approved upgrade icon from the same set: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only, not its shape. Image 2 is another approved icon of this set: match its finish only, not its shape.

Create an ORIGINAL icon of a roll-on aircraft gun kit: one 30 mm automatic cannon with a long slim dark gunmetal barrel and a slotted muzzle brake, on a low olive gun mount bolted to a flat steel cargo pallet with roller rails, a squarish olive ammunition box beside it. It points to the right.

Style: an icon for the game RimWorld: a very thick near-black outline around every shape, bold simple shapes, flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, a muted palette of dusty olive, steel grey and a touch of muted orange, readable when shrunk to 64 pixels. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

Draw ONLY the object, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about three quarters of the canvas. Square canvas. No people, hands, aircraft, text, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks.
